t:
Ooh la la! A banshee!

You know, I feel like a psychotherapist or a chaplain after a day of confessions. I haven't heard so many tearful stories since I was a student at the magic academy!

All our friends are left to do is weep about their failures. The Blue-Eyed Lady isn't there any more, so they chose me as their confidant.

I have to put up with it. Our weepers are very useful. They have a very special magic, which will be good against demons.
I hope no one saw you coming here. This is very very secret business.
Who are you? And who am I? How did I get here? And where is... here?
I feel... amazing. It’s nice to be alive!
It’s so nice to exist! But... something isn’t right... Wait, tell me – where is Nihaz?
Yes, Nihaz is my true overlord whose will directs and guides me! Don’t you all serve our Lord as well?

Stormbringer!

How interesting it is to see other allods that are so different from Ammer! We came when Zayan called on us to be present for an unprecedented act. Until now, our people were born from the pure energy of the Well of Souls, but what if it runs out one day? Will we be doomed with irrevocable losses like the Arisen?

If everything works out for you, this will be the dawn of a new era for the Aoidoi!

Greetings, Stormbringer!

With joy we received word from Zayan of what is happening here. You know what I am capable of feeling when it's time for another Aoidos to be born. I always look forward to it, so I can welcome the little one into this world and show them the way.

So I'm here waiting to see a new child of my people. I hope you succeed!

Are you suggesting they can be used as slaves?

Have no fear, Stormbringer, without the energy of the Well of Souls that’s impossible, and it is kept by three of our most trusted. If everything is successful, all that’s left is to make extra magical artifacts, saving the future of our people.

That’s impossible! How could that happen?

We used power directly from the Well of Souls that was collected recently...

Wait, . I think I am beginning to understand... When Kyros took the Well of Souls... He and the mage called the Wanderer were able to do something... something so inconspicuous that it didn't show up until we decided to play Creators! Galathy only openly talks about how the others... are hiding.

But... that doesn't mean... that Cosmos himself... No, that cannot be!

Listen, don't say anything to anyone, except Zayan. No one should know about this!

You're here? Good.

We’ll begin the brief.

Our goal is to try to create life. Yes, no more and no less!

To that end, we need: first of all, energy from the Well of Souls... Zayan gave it to me. Second, materials that Zayan gave me but you managed to collect.

Something could go wrong. Or maybe everything will go wrong!

That’s why we had to find a secluded place... where no one would disturb us, and we wouldn’t cause any harm.

Yes... I have extensive experience in past mistakes and disappointments.

Long has it been a dream of my people to tame the Astral and create directly from it. The Astral has been studied for hundreds of years now, but no one has even approached creating life!

However, the appearance of the Well of Souls and its divine energy changes everything! We’re trying to create a new Aoidos and breathe life into dead stone!

However, there is a chance it won’t work this time too! , be ready. Use your weapon if necessary!

Good memory. Yes, Ivan Gubarevsky asked me to make him a wife. Anyway, the misfortune only worked in his favor. Today he is quite happy with his frog. Rather, former frog.

As for me – I had to run from the law. It’s a good thing Zayan helped me hide...

Now I’m ready to try one more time, keeping previous mistakes in mind.

Long has it been a dream of my people to tame the Astral and create directly from it. The Astral has been studied for hundreds of years now, but no one has even approached creating life!

However, the appearance of the Well of Souls and its divine energy changes everything! We’re trying to create a new Aoidos and breathe life into dead stone!

However, there is a chance it won’t work this time too! , be ready. Use your weapon if necessary!
You know, fine. Demons are demons. I saw enough of them when we lived in Gorluxor's Tower on Yazes. But, of course, they were unusually black. I honestly don’t know why you're all so afraid of them.

Well, after Gorluxor’s defeat and the second death of Armando, we all ran for the hills. Carmilla, Armando’s wife, brought us to Amaranth. For some time we lived in the Patriarch's Residence, but when a bunch of heroes like you showed up, I had to flee to the depths of the allod. Carmilla disappeared, and then Wigo, one of Armando’s nephews, began to lead us. Of course, not everyone agreed when we created Amaranth and decided not to drink the blood of intelligent creatures. Many left. But my beloved Abelard and I decided to stay.

Really? It won't work! They'll never forgive us for what we've done, switching sides from Tep to Sarn. Politics is too messy, anyway. The House de Doucer used to be the strongest of the eight. When we made a mistake, they didn't want to listen. They just expelled us. We also suffered, but no one cared.
Ah, Gala, you are so naive, my dear... You have no idea what it means to be a vampire.

Hmm. Well, I trust him, which means I trust you. Although, if you think about it, nothing could have happened without you. Thank you for saving Eloise. That really moved us along... So, what do you think of this plan: my mother, Great Mage and the head of our House Antoinette de Delice, wants House de Doucer to return to the ranks of the elf Houses. That means amnesty and an end to persecution.

For victory in the Big Game, of course. Our House is graced with many qualities – including diplomacy. Yes, House de Doucer did become vampires... but they remained elves. I think, if they don’t kill anyone, they can certainly find a place among the elves. Perhaps even be cured. I’m talking about those who became vampires against their will... Or those who never became vampires but were arrested and exiled like Roxane and Stephane!

Worries? Alas, quite a lot. Most of all, King Louis de Desirae, head of House de Desirae and de facto ruler of all elves, has House de Doucer in his sights. That’s Prince Dakkar’s father, you should know. Dakkar himself, as you can see, separates Armando’s actions from those of other vampires. But Louis, in his day, confiscated the allod Nocturn from House de Doucer. Now he rules there and, of course, he is very opposed to its former owners’ return. In general, there are many in the League who remember what the vampires did... They themselves know that not everyone is ready to accept them. However, the current vampire leader, Wigo de Doucer, is apparently ready for talks.

I’m fine, you know. I’m getting along with the whole group actually. It’s a bit sad that many of us will likely perish, but... I've already died once, so I don’t fear it.

But... do you happen to know why that ghostly wretch from Gipat is staring at me?

What kind of plan can we have? I’ll place the key inside you, and you transfer its energy inside... Don’t look at me like that, , the key is actually completely immaterial!

Listen, the only thing you need to do is focus and stand in the center of the Seal. The key’s energy will flow through you. I’ll make sure of it.

A squad of elite zombies will go with you – use them to take care of Nihaz’s defenders. Well, shall we begin?

Hmm... The question is, do you need to know?

Fine, I think you did more than enough to earn the right to hear this information.

So, the Keys. As we know now, they are part of the Seal created by Nihaz. You have already encountered them more than once... There should be twelve keys in all. We know about some, but others remain lost.

On its own, a Key can do a lot. After all, it’s a piece of divine power, directly connected to its source in the Seal.

Well, why do you think?

Using the Key of Darkness, Tep created his Plague...

And, quite frankly, it was the Keys that broke our world up into allods.

It’s hard to say when exactly the Keys appeared in the world, but it was long before the Cataclysm. I think Nihaz gave them out to those he wanted to control for his own purposes. Remember, he trusted one of the Keys to you – during the events on Kirah.

The Conclave of Great Mages was created precisely when the elves received some of these Keys. We’ve hunted them for a long time. With time, we discovered the Seals themselves. Without understanding what was before us, we decided we could break them up and make even more Keys out of them.

Naturally, that was the purpose of the Great Experiment.

That’s a good question, which I only have a partial answer to.

Each of the keys corresponds to a certain astral element and, besides that, a certain force.

There are three levels of force. Elemental – fire, air, water, earth. Divine –  light, darkness, order, chaos. And the highest are Creator forces – destruction, creation, death and life.

I have the Key of Fire – you already know it as the  Grain of Protopower. The Key of Water is most likely what protected you from the Destroyers. If you didn’t lose it, you must still have it.

I believe the Key of Air was used by us to open one of the Seals. Now it’s destroyed, but both it and the Seal can never be completely annihilated.

The Key of Order is also lost. The Key of Darkness is still in the dungeons on the Wandering Isle, though Tep broke it into pieces and kept a shard.

We acquired the Key of Chaos again just recently. I won’t even risk guessing where the remaining Keys could be.
The world is full of mysteries...

We’ll see what happens!

Let’s start already. My men are hungry for battle! We will take revenge on this bastard for manipulating us like puppets. Oh, I’m going to smash Gorislav’s face if I see him! And he called himself Gipitsky to be like us, the bastard!
Someone saw dragonlings the size of gnats flying around here. I’ll deal with them promptly! Smack – flat as a pancake!
Yeah right, I’m not the first! Me and the guys will last thirty times longer than you need to kill Nihaz! Go on and don’t think about what you're getting into...

Take it easy, don’t panic...We’ve seen worse. Just listen, I’m tired and it's hard to talk... A sloop is going to dock on the starboard side for a short while. Run for it. Don’t worry about the others. Some are already on ships, some are teleporting or leaving through the lower decks... We can’t evacuate anyone via the main entrance. It’s too dangerous.

Everything is going great so far! The defense systems and shields aren’t letting a single demon through, damn right! Nihaz, that dog, first tried to break through our starboard side, and then port, but we’re showing him what we’re made of...

Listen, buddy, why don’t you help the guys out on starboard side, huh? They’re doing fine, of course, but it will be fun for you and easier for them!
One of my boys will accompany you, so you don’t get lost on this juggernaut! Well, everything clear?

Think with your head! Something in the generator went haywire again... It’s not so simple keeping that thing going! And the demons... what will hold them back now... Hurry to the engineers while we still hold the deck!
I think they just stand the way they were placed. Just don't touch them!
First catch some prey! Don’ be lazy!
Personal business, eh... Fine, go ahead. I don’t want to get a beating from him.

Oh, my... Dangerous business. Every rat knows me in there! And that loud-mouth Grot is too much!

Well fine, I’ll tighten my helmet over my ears, so no one recognizes me. Those psychos with antennae on their heads will definitely detect who I am!

Oh no.

But Kork promised to help, right? The captain’s word... I mean the ordinary goblin Kork's word is like steel! So!

I’m ready!
I’m glad to see you in good health, Stormbringer.
As you can see, we have a small problem...

Please don’t talk about my colleague in the past tense! Of course I know her, comrade !

This is Sarang Meritneith, a leading imperial scientist. She works at ZIT in the Office of Astral Achievements! In recent years, she has been working on a project for a secret research vessel named Infinity.

Its crew was recently selected from the Empire’s best and brightest. My colleagues from the Committee were among them. And Sarang Meritneith apparently also wanted to take her own ship on the journey.

Infinity…

Nice name, right? That was the name of the Empire’s newest research vessel, built using the latest technology.

We need to know what our enemy is planning, right? Infinity was supposed to be our eyes and ears in the depths of the astral. They didn’t need to fight anyone. Just observe and record. But apparently something went very wrong.

And no matter how important the team is to us, right now our highest priority is to find out what happened.

That will be clear when we understand what we're dealing with.

And in order to understand, we need to go there and see everything for ourselves. That’s why I need you now.

Don't worry. You won’t be alone. You’ll have your own team. We just need to wait for its final member.
Stormbringer? But... How did you get here?!

From the future? If you're here, that means losing that ship has terrible consequences... But how do we find it?

We answered the call, but we only found empty astral and old traces from a ship that jumped. Jumping through all the wormholes in a row is too dangerous. We can’t find them all...

That's what a ship leaves behind after space teleportation. When it jumps, a ship sort of creates its own wormhole, which it moves through. But this wormhole has been closed for some time. All that’s left is a tiny distortion that will soon disappear. If only we could force it open again...

Eureka! Of course, Cosmos thought of everything!

If we connect this inverter to the artillery, and aim at what’s left of the wormhole...

He said... it was safe! He sent us here! Cosmos... But we didn't know... No one could foresee...

Infinity. My creation. My dream. The Empire must not fall behind! The Infinity can reach the deepest layers of the Astral!

We were preparing for this expedition for a year. A long flight. A search. We finally found what we needed!

The Seal! It radiated power, all our detectors went haywire. So much power... We were taking readings... and suddenly... it emitted something!

We saw... I don't know what we saw... Chaos! Distortion! Absolute madness. No, no. I can't describe that!

The darkness engulfed us! Darkness brought Chaos with it. I'd only felt that once before. The day... I died.

My companions...

They went... mad? Darkness swallowed them, turned them into something different! I saw rage in their eyes, endless rage! They were ready to kill... and they killed... tore each other apart...! And themselves! And those who didn't go mad!!

Yes. Those who remained the same... were the Arisen. All of them... I don’t understand why...

They... tried to resist... to fight... But... they all died!

I managed to escape. I hid in the cabin and sealed the door! I was the one who sent the distress signal!

I... need to show you something... You must believe me!

Well... Your story allows us to conclude that the Arisen are the reason. Their essence.

In recent years we've learned a lot about Tep's legacy, curse his soul. I received a report about the things they discovered on the so-called Wandering Island where Sarn's cultists were dealing with the Plague.

We know that Tep created his Plague using a shard of Nihaz's Seal. It must be the answer. After experiencing the effects of the Darkness once, we developed some kind of immunity to it.

It's just a theory, but it seems reasonable. I'm not willing to risk my brethren's lives by exposing them to this kind of influence, but if you encounter a creature that has lived through something similar, I ask you to run a test on it. We need to find out what these cursed demons are like... What are they made of?
Ollum stares at Hort Sobes with naked horror and regret.
[You hear a stream of visions and emotions coming from Ollum. The demon is agitated. He speaks of demons and Nihaz's curse. That the entire Sogot is in danger.]
The best defense is offense! Have you heard that before?

But we know where his Seal is. There's must be something important behind it, since it's so well-protected.

Nihaz is cunning, powerful, and dangerous, but he has his weak spots. I'm certain "Daddy" hid a few interesting things somewhere, and we can use them to cause a lot of trouble!

Of course, we need a key to unlock the Seal, but I think I might have an idea where we can find it. And of course, "Daddy's" trinkets will be guarded. That's why we need an army to breach those defenses...

...and then we'll send a horde of heroes inside!

From the Queen? Hand it over, it must be something important. Let's see...

"...first of all... don't throw... we'll go to... meddlesome guests... at your discretion... frog..."

Hm, frog...?

Ah, you're a "great hero", right?

You must remember how you boarded the Eclipse together with a couple dozen heroes and thrashed the place.

Yes, yes, I was there, keeping you from getting to the upper deck.

Remember my walls of fire? I did fry a couple of "heroes", didn't I?

But you went through anyway, leaving my cold body behind. I spend a long time in the Purgatory! Fortunately, I managed to come back, but not everyone was so lucky. Poor Ignat is still there...

But let bygones be bygones. The Queen commands, and I obey. I'll have to put up with your presence.

Oh, a familiar face. Been a while, eh?

What brings you here? If you're looking for a job, you've come to the right place. We could use a hand.
There's not much time... Go to the Whirlpool, travel to the past and find the Infinity.

It's a magnificent structure. I know very little about it and can only see what Nihaz decided to leave in the open - factories where demons are corrupted; active time and space portals; Spark storage... If you find one, I won't be surprised if you see Sparks of certain heroes from the past inside it. Even those who are presumed gone forever.

Lots of interesting things. We were wondering how a prison for a god would work. This place controls everything.

The Citadel controls Seals that keep everything in Sarnaut inside this world. When I say "everything", it means literally everything. Why was Nihaz believed to be the Zem god of death? It's simple. What do you think happens to the Sparks that "fade away"?

They go to Nihaz. To his "Box", a space where they continue to exist. There's your master of death! Where do you think he got Ath-Zak's Spark? Even Tep didn't come up with his traps on his own - he studied one of Daddy's keys.

There's more! How did Nihaz grant you your Gift of Resurrection? It's simple - at some point, Nihaz set up the Citadel in a way that the Stream of Sparks was flowing through the Purgatory he created, so they were returned to newly healed bodies. Sophisticated magic plus wicked technology - and there you have it!

After all the dealings with the Seals, the world has become rather tattered. Have you noticed that gods leave this world? They escape Sarnaut through some loophole. But we can't use it.

Still curious about Daddy's tricks? So you must have noticed that gods and demigods sometimes "break apart". They are quite fragile, these gods - their power is too immense, so it sometimes rips them apart. But let's get back to the Servant of Tensess, who is, of course, not a servant and has absolutely nothing to do with Tensess.

This Servant is actually a soldier from that very first ship where the crew was revived for the first time. But it's not just that! The poor guy was possessed by a tiny particle of the God of Light who went crazy and started falling apart by then. And to top it all, he has a key to Sacred Blessing in his sword hilt. You gave it to him - because of your faith.

Nihaz himself never expected that chance and your blind faith would essentially create a new God of Light. The guy doesn't fully realize it himself, though. He got that blind hatred for Nihaz from Sarn... that's why he meddled in our affairs when me and Daddy toyed with Creation. For a Servant, this magic is like an alarm bell.

And he leaks power like a sieve - Sarn's fragment continues to crumble. He gave some of it to the Cradle - that's why it started spewing all these incarnations of dreams. And some went to our Claire Brightley, turning her into another slightly crazed deity of Light. She's still out there, by the way. Don't think you got rid of her permanently.

Hmm. Warfare data. Enemy movements data. Victory reports...

You know, this may seem very abstract to you, but for me... this is very personal. Alright, no time for melancholy.

You probably still have a question from the moment when Zak told you about the true revelation of Tka-Rik. What did Sarn and Nihaz disagree about? What happened that the God of Darkness was forced to capture the God of Light?

It's just a petty detail, one event among many events of the Great War. Yes, that's what we called it. It can also be called the Uprising of Nihaz. A rebel! A riot! A revolution, after all.

You know that this world isn't the only world in the universe. There are others. There are as many worlds as grains of sand on a beach of the Summer Atoll. Each world has its own gods. The gods aren't equal. They can be weak, there are patrons of savage tribes, but there are those who can create worlds. Demiurges! And even among them, there are stronger and weaker gods...

The rebellious Nihaz decided to challenge the strongest of them. He grabbed all disgruntled and threw them into the fire of his rebellion! The war lasted for millions of years. Worlds were destroyed. Gods fought. Do you remember when I said that Nihaz became something bigger? The concept of conflict? The very idea of war? Exactly!

The war still continues. Sarnaut is also involved, whether we like it or not.

You know that this world isn't the only world in the universe. Somewhere out there is the original world of Sarn, and in some other place you can find the world from which the Servants of Nihaz came, these funny hooded dragons.

Here in the Citadel, we gather information about all events in the world. Nihaz is on the warpath. And yes, the conflict with Sarn that gave birth to Sarnaut is only part of this Great War.

It's still going.

One of the parties were the Architects. Not so long ago, these zealots of Order turned the world into a part of the Fractal. They were unstoppable. Nihaz feared them for good reason: Darkness, Light, Life, or Death could not stand against the perfect Order.
But you and I were able to destroy the central core of this God's mind, a single person with many entities. And now the Architects outside of Sarnaut have gone mad, fighting each other.

This made it possible for all those worlds outside the astral plane to reject the enemy. They don't know who they should thank, but it's you. You managed to save lives - billions of living beings.

Of course, Nihaz also took advantage of this victory. But trust me, I have a plan to deal with him now.

It's not much - the coordinates of one of the worlds you will probably have to visit soon.

Not another word! Before we can use them, we still have a lot to do. And perhaps we could use the help of Catherina and the Empire. Progress can give us something the most powerful magic cannot.
We need to banish Nihaz from this world once and for all. But it won't be easy.
We're finally here... The barrier around this level won't let us advance any further. We'll need time to understand what can be done about it.
I think Nogrom has an idea on how to deal with the barrier. When you're ready, we'll start our assault.

I'll try to explain.

As you already know, worlds are destroyed and rebuilt by the gods. This is part of the Great Cycle, a natural process. While creating more and more new worlds, the gods are not trying to invent anything, they have ready-made templates also known as Eidoi.

Control Cubes are sets of standard Eidoi. I don’t know how Nihaz got it, but I think he couldn’t use it.

I'll hack it, but as for using it...

You won't be able to either, sorry. You need to be a Great Mage at the least. Give it to Catherina? It's dangerous, and I wouldn't want to distract her now. I have my own plans for the Queen of Umoir...

Aidenus and Yasker wouldn't do either - we don't want the League or the Empire to have a clear advantage, do we?

Well, the only candidate I can think of is Nefer Ur. He will keep everything a secret, and he is smart enough to use it wisely.

Give it to Nefer Ur - and keep quiet about what you have discovered. And I will contact you when it's time.
This seal is protecting my tower. No one can pass through it, not even I.

I... I don’t know. The crystal just exploded in my hands. I've grown so weak over the centuries... But I'll think of something.

But nothing will work without a crystal. The shards are down there, on the bottom of the rift. I only have one... Take it. The shards are pulled towards each other. This shard will help you find the rest on the bottom of the rift.

To combine them into a whole crystal, you'll need extra magical energy. I sense echoes of magic among the shards on the bottom - they'll serve as a good energy source.

Go. And come back soon.

The soul sphere attracts local ghosts, consumes them and transfers their power to its owner. I can destroy the sphere, but ghosts can disrupt my ritual. I need your help.

Tell me when to start.

This door leads to the artifact storage. Powerful items and scrolls were kept there under the protection of our spells.

That was before Veligrad fell - and with it, the protection of the storage. Treasure hunters must have plundered it since then. And that bloody spirit is in there now.

If only I paid more attention to my apprentices...

I can unveil the seals, and you must use the Soul Catcher to catch the souls bound to the seal.

Just be careful! If you touch a wrong soul, I'll be in trouble.

Try not to get me killed, alright?

[Dakkar is muttering something, trying to warn you. He says something about a scroll. He's about to pass out, he's feeling worse.

With great difficulty, he moves his hand to give you something.

It's the Dead Bone Horn.]
We did it... Urd's ghost is gone, I can feel it.

It's because of the three sisters hungry for power.

There's so much forbidden magic here... and the temptation was too strong.

Urd was... very powerful. It's hard to say where he learned so many horrible secrets... how he managed to create this Summoner Guild... Perhaps he used Tep's legacy? Or something even more dangerous?

Even though he died by our hands in battle... his spirit continued to live. A part of him remained in his notes. And these foolish girls awakened him. Urd's will was so strong it continued to influence the dead in the ruins of Veligrad. And it grew stronger still.

Perhaps you'd like to see what happened in the Tower that day? I'll show you...

You really haven't head anything about him?

After defeating the Demon here on Umoir, Skrakan noticed that something strange was happening on Yazes. Some dark magic connected to the Astral.

He was looking for someone he could send there. And I became that messenger.

I would have failed if I didn't meet the noble Iglez and the enchanter's granddaughter Dinah.  We traveled all over the allod before we uncovered the Great Mage Urd's plans.

After becoming the leader of the Summoner Guild, Urd managed to turn the king of Yazes into a zombie. He had all the power, but Iglez exposed his plans and won the nobles over to his side. The local druids also joined him.

Even though the allies didn't all get along, they succeeded. We gathered our army and approached Yazes. Iglez defeated Urd in a long and hard battle. Of course, I did my part. Nothing would have worked if he hadn't found the shards of the crown that protected its owner against the Astral magic... And it was very difficult to collect the "Three Stars"- the three shards.

So Iglez and Dinah got married, and I returned to Umoir to become an apprentice of Skrakan's and the keeper of the tower that held Urd's scroll.

I assume they quarreled and went separate ways in the end.

The scroll was torn, and Urd's spirit was freed.

This dark magic... has consequences. His grave was too close to the tower.

Everything went downhill since then and eventually the Orcs and marauders tore the place apart.

But the sisters are still somewhere around here. I dread to imagine what has become of them.

Don't you know me? I'm the famous scholar Alfred de Delice. Perhaps you read my monograph on the Siverian undead? I carried out research for a few years in this cold land. My apprentice Christina helped me.

Perhaps academic science was far from the forefront of your mind these past few years, which is understandable.

I'm carrying out two important missions here. One from Zayan himself... We'll talk about it later. The second one is about the affairs of my House. I can't talk about that one, I'm sorry. But as you can see, we're trying to begin our work... It's strange. I've dealt with the Kanians and Gibberlings before, but I've never faced such attitude.

And now I'm forced to endure... this.
Let them try and get close!
Ah, no. We have a good reason to be here, and we won't let them scare us away. I'm not moving from this spot until they leave.

I won't waste my breath! We know their tricks. You start listening to them, they enchant you to the point where you forget who you are.

No, thanks!
Why shouldn't we? This is our home, they have no business hanging around here! Umoir for Umoir people! Clear Valley is ours!

Guests? They're not guests! They are invaders! They sit around in our tavern, doing god knows what, eating our food like they have the right to do so. We don't need guests like that! We didn't invite them!
How can you act like this...

To speak with someone, you need them to be able to speak.

All they do is yell since the morning.

What, you don't remember the incredibly talented, beautiful and charming artist who painted pictures on Gipat?

It's been years! But I'm still an artist. It's all I ever dream about! Here on Umoir I found my inspiration again. I want to picture these lands in all their wild glory!

Alas, I'm always busy. I'm on an important mission from my mother, a Great Mage and the head of my House - Antoinette de Delice. I can't let her down.

And now this...
It's not easy to offend the lot of them! Just look at their faces! They do a lot of that themselves. We didn't do anything. And we don't need to justify ourselves!
Oh you knife-eared vermin! We'll show you!
Who are you to tell us what to do? Get out of here!
Want to give this one a beating, too?
So you're with them? We'll deal with you next!
We'll show you an artist, a knife-eared sympathizer!
Who are you? I don't know you.
Stolen, you say? Well, it serves him right. Doing business with bloodsuckers, bringing disgrace on our village. I haven't seen any amulets.
Ah, this? It's... my mother's. Or rather, grandmother's. I inherited it. Lovely, isn't it?
What do you mean, what? The wine! Look, there's one bottle left. How else would we drown our sorrows?
I need to get back to... hiccup...! work.
It's to protect myself... hiccup...! against bloodsuckers. They don't like hops in blood, so they won't bite me. It definitely works on gnats so it should work on ghouls, too.

As for the politics, things are bad in our homeland. The old Kania is gone, the soul of the nation is nobility. Foreigners control everything. Foreigners and rabble. There's no order, just endless disquiet.

Instead of investigating conspiracies of elves and Gibberlings, the authorities are persecuting old dynasties!

Have you heard the news? We are allied with demons now! Demons! It's not something our forefathers could have foreseen. Shame!

My dear friends!

I'm thankful for your response and I'd like to tell you this.

I've been informed that Gala de Delice is about to start negotiations with House de Doucer in the near future. It's about amnesty and dropping all charges. House de Doucer will be given an opportunity to return to the elven society as one of the minor Houses.

We can't let that happen! We must disrupt these negotiations. Alas, Catherina decides what I'm allowed to do here in Clear Valley, but perhaps I can convince her. Our chances will be higher if you prove that the vampires can't be trusted.

Thank you for everything you do!
Leave me... or I'll kill you...

I was captured in the forest when I was hunting. These humans... They locked me in this foul cage... starved me... They were about to hand me over to the mob... I wanted to kill them as soon as they opened the cage... Despite my oath...
I swore never to drink human blood... Our house swore this oath. We have subsisted on animal blood for a long time, but these humans... They left me no choice.
Her goal is noble but very difficult to achieve. We stopped attacking humans but it wasn't enough... Humans should stop attacking us.

[The vampire's stare is hungry]

I just want to go home and never see this place again.

I promise I won't touch anyone if you let me out...
We are the true saviors of this land. The dead shouldn't wander aimlessly - let them rest in the ground or serve the living.

Ahem…

I was the Colonel of the Imperial Army... My regiment was sent to Umoir five years ago when we realized what was going on there. Our scouts reported that the Blight consumed these lands...

We were hiding in the local ruins... when they told me about a powerful artifact discovered in the ruins of Veligrad.

We set out... and ran into those who got here before us... Pirates... and Kanians with the cursed inquisitor... Cough...

It was a tough battle, we had to attack and retreat, attack and retreat... And then something terrible happened. We lost the regimental banner! Brought eternal shame upon ourselves! We all died here, but I'll never rest... unless I recover the banner!
What...? Why are you stopping me? Haven't you heard what he did to me?!

Yes... that's right.

I was in love once... with a girl.

It was a time when Catherina brought Light to these heathen lands... We were building churches, destroying heathen temples...

Here in the Valley I met her, the beautiful blue-eyed lady...

I fell in love... our romance... was short-lived, like the last warm days before winter...

I was horrified to discover she was a witch! I had a choice - her... or my brothers and my faith.

I made my choice...

But now that my life ended in that battle in Veligrad, my soul can't find peace...
Oh la la! I love my job... But that smell...
I see you've killed all the ghouls but haven't raised any. What am I going to tell Dakkar?

Pathetic fool!

I am Galenel, a loyal apprentice and Herald of Skrakan's, the hero of Yazes who defeated the Great Mage Urd. I am the keeper of Veligrad Tower, library, and Skrakan's artifact storage!

Save the world? From what?

What are you talking about? Demons, gods... That sounds like a drunkard's tale!
What do you want to know?

After the festivities, I left Iglez and Dinah on Yazes and went back to Umoir. That's when the new Xadaganian mage arrived - Kir... Nezeb's loyal servant. Nezeb was disturbed by the events... He heard that Urd planned to dethrone the Emperor and take his place.

Xadagan politics took a different turn then - Nezeb no longer trusted his allies in the Conclave who was there before the Cataclysm. He started replacing them with those he trusted implicitly. Kir was one of them.

Iglez didn't want Kir to get hold of Urd's belongings, so he entrusted all the notes and artifacts to me.

Skrakan knew what happened by then. He decided to store all "forbidden" grimoires and artifacts in the same place. We picked a small city for that purpose - Veligrad.

Here we built the Tower that was later named after me. We moved all of Urd's works here. Together with my apprentices, I studied them and searched for ways to combat this dark magic.

I became an apprentice of Skrakan's... But my work completely consumed me, so I opted out of the Great Mage test. Oh, I still lived much longer than other people.

Veligrad stood strong for many years... Skrakan kept other things in the storage besides artifacts. Urd found his final rest here on Umoir - even after death, Great Mages are dangerous, and Skrakan didn't want the body of the former Soul Eater to be disturbed.

Everything changed when Leviathan gathered a horde of orcs and goblins that roamed Umoir. They rampaged through the northern lands... Al Rihat fell, followed by Veligrad. They could not withstand the attack. The storage was plundered...
I welcome you to our abode - Amarantha!

I know why you're here. It's strange, isn't it? You live your life and close your eyes to our existence, convinced that there will never be a time when you need our help. Life is full of twists and turns. I'm aware of the kind of help you require, but what can you offer in return?

That's right. You don't know! It's a good thing I'm more given to deliberation than either you or Zayan. I can think of a favor of equal value, but I don't have time for pointless discussion. First I need to prove to my brethren that you are worthy of our trust. The decision is not solely mine to make. Nothing that will require tremendous effort on your part - just our everyday challenges.

Yes, yes, it's all very interesting but I have no time for chit-chat. The last assignment before we can move on to more serious matters is Abelar. He commands respect but I'm not certain whether he is... in full control of his mental faculties. His issues are likely to be a figment of his imagination, but you must go and ascertain if that's true.

I'm counting on that. Of course, we have no intention of expanding our borders, but it can help us... improve our defenses somewhat. In any case, I have a few more tasks for you - of lesser significance. Our dear Edward, the soul of Amarantha, has been out of sorts. Something caused this, and I charge you with the task of resolving it.

Good news. I suppose I can give you a more difficult task now. Genevieve is working on something that would allow us to face groups of armed villagers without fear. Go to her, she'll give you the details. You'd be surprised how much we've learned about cloning technology.
A vampire's life is a nightmare.

Public pressure. We've been isolated for a while. I don’t know why, but the locals are becoming more and more hostile to us. I don't think they just up and decided to turn against us for no reason - that doesn't happen...

Oh, we have many problems! We used to be able to buy blood from volunteers - in secret, mind you... We thought we found the best way to go about it: we paid the druids to cleanse blighted animals for us, but there have been difficulties, and they no longer help us... And the old folk are too cautious to work with us in secrecy.
I need time to figure out if this blood is a suitable food source for us. And we need to observe the unicorns as well - to see if these "procedures" affect them in any way.
I'm trying to provide the city with food. I wouldn't say I enjoy it, but someone has to do it, and I at least have the capacity and competence to take it on.
How do you think that goes? Hunting humans is a taboo, and everything else is infected with the Blight. We are searching for other solutions, but our efforts have been fruitless so far.

The manual says, "Cloning apparatus calibration process is simple: even a monkey could do it! While calibrating the device, watch the temperature reading and adjust the power accordingly: reduce it if it rises and increase it if it drops. The process takes less than a minute!"

The volume opens on the page you need:

"Sensors must be attached to the 13 parts of the capsule as pictured, then a test launch should be carried out.

In the first half minute, it is necessary to carefully monitor the readings of the sensors and make necessary adjustments to the operation of the device (reduce power at high values and lower it at low values).

It was experimentally established that, if there is no emergency shutdown of the systems in half a minute, then the device is successfully calibrated."

I'm moving us forward! I'm in charge of artifacts, arts, and sciences. Our curse is not an excuse to stagnate.

My current interest is Gorluxor's cloning apparatus. As you can guess, we managed to grab a few when we escaped the Tower. I picked up a few things while the old man was away painting my friends in the nude.

I also have a few blood samples... not just from the humans in the village, although I secured those first. The cultists had a special bank that allowed them to revive Sarn's servants. I got hold of the bank, but it will take me a while to sort through it.

Unfortunately, there's not much time. I'm expected to provide results soon.

The world around us is cruel, and Wigo says we need to be able to defend ourselves, and this is a great opportunity to make us more powerful, even if it's dangerous. But I promise we'll be careful.

It's easier than it looks! You attach a sensor - and if you see the indicator move upward, you reduce power, and when it moves downward, increase it. Watch it for about half a minute, and it should stabilize. These devices were created by a genius, so even an idiot can use them.
How dreadful! This is embarrassing! Go away, leave me alone...
Aren't they sweet? So observant! But they know nothing...
You...? Well, you don't look like an expert in these matters and I've never seen you before in my life...

Sounds reasonable... Anyway, I clearly can't deal with it myself, and I'd never share it with anyone in Amarantha, that's simply not an option! But first you must promise that no one else will find out!
Well, perhaps you are the best person for the job... I'll tell you everything, but you must promise that no one will hear about this!
I'm sorry, but no... Life taught me never to trust these "jacks of all trades".

So I'll be honest, it's about love. I'm in love with Bella, a noble lady from Clear Valley...

Everything was fine until this dirty beast showed up. It must have used some kind of hypnosis to draw her attention!

I saw its tracks new her house... Anyone else would've overlooked it, but elves and vampires have an eye for these things!

I'll do anything for my love. So the task is simple - find it, kill it, and bring me its head!

The beast lives in the forest nearby, I'll mark it on the map. It should be easy to find this shapeshifter, there are rumors of a pensive and non-aggressive shapeshifter wandering the woods... The others of its kind are vicious monsters! You need to kill only this one. Well, you can kill others as well, I don't care about these creatures.
Wow, that's impressive! But why? It's not the... Ah, whatever. Give it here, I'll find some use for it. Just don't tell anyone.
You are looking at a purple mushroom. You have seen them before, but there is something unusual about this one...

You open the last pages and read:

"The apple worked splendidly! Old methods always work unlike this modern magic...

I put a spell on the girl - she thinks she brings pies to her grandmother, but she actually brings me blood for my enchantments. Everyone in their city trusts each other, no one would suspect a thing...

She just needs to keep her mouth shut and not get too frail, or else they might notice..."
What?! That pig?! He promised we wouldn't be hurt if we left peacefully! He even showed up himself! What are you, his pet?
That's right. You should kill that dog, Wigo.
Ah, I see... It's your decision.
That's your decision. But we won't strike the first blow.

So that's why you're here... I thought we'd die for our cause, not because of this tyrant's cruelty. We won't go down without a fight. The Blight will protect us - you'll see it after the first blow you strike.
That's... Unusual. Thank you. There's nothing we can do to help you, but we won't forget.

It's our business, darling. What matters is, we stay out of your way, and you stay out of ours. We won't harm those who hasn't done us harm. It was different before we left Amarantha, but now... We are our own masters. We will hide our secrets so no one else can hurt us.
Wow, we don't get guests often...

I was watching from the side. I can't oppose Wigo directly - it would be a suicide, so I could only watch. When demons showed up, it changed everything. It was utter chaos, so I managed to take you away... Again. My wings took a hit, though. And you were hurt, too.

Why do you think? You saved me, so I saved you. Honestly, I didn't expect Wigo to go through with it. Things were never easy for us, but at least we acted with honor. Amarantha has changed, and I no longer wish to be a part of this... society. So I don't regret my decision.

They isolated themselves, closed the doors on the outside world. They are probably plotting something. Wigo's arrogance is justified - he is strong and clever, and with the cloning equipment... I don't think they'll make a move so soon, but in the long term, they can become a serious threat. Although it's not my problem anymore.

Well, you survived a difficult fight, and then an attack by demons... But judging by your pale skin, you're talking about something else. You might have been bitten. If that's the case, you'll find out soon. I can't give you any advice. As you can see, I haven't been able to escape the curse myself... Ask someone who knows more on the subject.

I don't know yet. I'll stay here for now. I have nowhere else to go, and I know these parts well. You should return to your friends and tell them what happened. You clearly hoped the vampires would aid you, and all you have is one vampire at best. Hah.

I'm glad you see that. Our brethren seem to have lost their ability to appreciate these things. They are too absorbed in their troubles, worries, and curses... We left and settled here, away from everything that weighs them down. Now we are always happy. They told us this life is no better than death, but the kind of existence some of them lead is much worse than any death.
Come closer. You want to talk?

We are the worshippers of the Blight! While everyone else is building walls to hide behind, searching for a way to cure it - we welcome it and its spawns as the next stage of evolution. We are not trying to spread it. It does it all by itself. We study it to better understand what it creates... Of course, we became exiles even among our brethren, but no one who truly believes is bothered by it.
Have you come to join us?
Don't waste my time, do what you came here to do.
Follow that road, you'll see a structure that's different from others. Wigo is always on the premises.
At the end of the road, you will see two ladies on the right. They sit there all day long. Ask them.
We built a beautiful garden to the right of the road, behind the buildings. Outlanders are not allowed, but you seem to be a special kind of guest.
I'm the son of the most honorable vampire, and I keep the people of Amarantha safe.
Wigo...? Sounds about right, we were told about this. Be careful, we don't trust strangers here.
What do you want to know?
My thoughts go round and round. I wonder where we are going. And whether we are really going anywhere, and so on, and so forth, and then I think about the meaning of all this... Is this even real...?

You see who I am. Who I was a minute ago is in the past, and who I will become in the future is unknown. I'll just say I sought many things in my life, but here amidst all worries and troubles, in the city of outcasts, I found peace.
The only thing they can't take away - watching the world, enjoying ourselves and appreciating the nature around us... Come sit with us, relax for a minute!
I think he... left to observe other worlds...

We came to this allod when de Desirae took our home. They accused us of so many things. Louis de Desirae used it as an excuse to get his paws on our Nocturne.

All great houses have their House: de Ardeur have Lumenara, de Blizare, Vevre, Grandeur, Delice, and Pluie have Gelida, Florenta, Stellara, Ignista and Tempesta. De Desirae have a small Tenebra... It's no wonder they were jealous.

And now we are doomed to endure this wretched existence in a remote corner of Umoir!

I went here a second time after that setback on Avilon... and our defeat in the Demons' City. So they're saying Sarn is gone? We are lucky to outlive so many... Perhaps I'll be able to go back home someday.
Wait, do I know you? Your face looks familiar... Never mind.
Arts. I spent most of my life doing mundane things, but my soul wanted something more.
When you learn to weave words into patterns - then, with new knowledge, you can return to me. Until then it's simple: I sit here, and you don't bother me.
Of course. It's not hard work, if that's what you mean.
And extra information. You'd realize it if you gave it some thought... In our situation, it would be a mistake not to take advantage of it. That's how it is, darling.
Let us girls keep our secrets, dear. You don't need to know everything, so be careful there.

My story is a long one! Are you willing to listen?

Everything started ten years ago in the tower of a Great Mage. I went there on a mission from my Patriarch. I needed to summon a Shadow that would strike the very Spark of Clement de Desirae. Their family took away our allod, and we became exiles!

Some Kanian nobles and rebels who served the White Knight were a part of this. The Knight joined Tep at the time, and my Patriarch also had ties to Tep.

I accomplished my mission... But I was unlucky to run into a young hero, a vagabond... who looked a bit like you... but maybe not. He interfered... I tried to escape through the portal, but something went wrong. I was thrown somewhere else... And I lost track of my brother Arsen who was with me...

I wandered through allods for years, doing deeds that would be glorified in songs. I visited the snowy Lightwood! Saw exploding hares on Jigran! Sank into the quicksands of Suslanger! Climbed the Great Trea on Yakhch! Hid in the foggy valley on Forox! Fought off bandits in the lair of the Gray Prince!

Finally, I was reunited with my family! Even though I had to become a vampire... I only regret that my brother is not with me.
I observe, meditate. I like watching her work. She's so... blunt and determined. So different from other elves...
I record everything and everyone that enters Amarantha. In our situation, order is one of the few things we can rely on. Unfortunately, not everyone shares that view.
That's commendable, but everyone already knows you're here. Go in and do something useful.
! Everything is fine, thank you. There's peace and stability in Amarantha for a change. And you're still trying to help out, I see? That's admirable.
Amarantha's Clerk. I hold its history, properties and affairs in my hands. I have nothing for you, but I'll make sure to record your contribution to our history.
Hello! Amarantha is a wonderful place, is it not?
What we are famous for, of course. Paintings, other pieces of art... special goods from ancient times. And of course, boring common goods. Would you like to buy something, dear?
That's not for you or for anyone outside Amarantha to know, darling. Leave our secrets to us.

You see a chest with strange contents. Somehow you can read the inscription. It says,

"You can hold only one."
[You carefully pick up the bear head and discover that the mirror is gone.]
[You carefully pick up the bear head.]
[You carefully pick up the bear head and discover that the stick is gone.]
[You carefully pick up the mirror and discover that the bear head is gone.]
[You pick up the mirror and discover that the stick is gone.]
[You pick up the stick and discover that the bear head is gone.]
[You pick up the stick and discover that the mirror is gone.]
Fortunately or unfortunately, no one responds to your remark.
You see the wise woman's dead body. It seems to be the girl whose house you searched just recently...
[You leaf through the book. There are clearly more pages than there should be, and they turn at the lightest touch. You see descriptions of various days, rituals, and spells...]

[You leaf through the book and find many interesting notes]:

Witches. They say witchcraft comes from the darkness of time... The first sorcerers were trained by the Elven Conclave which established the rules and regulations of magic. But there were those who ignored all rules and regulations. Their names are hidden and all but forgotten, but there are legends of the Raven Queen and the leader of the Wild Horde.

They were banished by the Conclave, but not all knowledge can be crossed out. Those who sought power ignored all rules and found the hidden books. That was how witchcraft was born. Dark, evil magic, it absorbed the legacy of Zem and Aro tribes. Then the June blood magic, shamanism, and the folk magic traditions of small nations.

Umoir witches are a special case. There have always been dense forests and abandoned villages where anyone can take refuge. It's no surprise there were so many of them here. But they came into power only after the fall of Veligrad. When Leviathan razed the city, Skrakan's artifact storage was also destroyed. The witches gained a lot of power in those ruins.

Whatever they are hiding must be very interesting. Who knows what they stole?

[The note you are reading is dated yesterday]:

Finally! I begged and begged for years, but the old hag wouldn't be fooled. She finally deemed me worthy of becoming her apprentice. And it's real magic, not some tricks! With her powers, I won't have to pretend to be some "wise woman" anymore and heal local cretins, praying that no one decides they want to burn me at the stake...

She is hiding in Foul Dale, near the hunters' camp. I know that place, I'm leaving everything and going there tonight...

[You open the bookmarked page]:

Witches can trick human senses and keep things hidden from them. But someone with a pure soul can fight the illusion - if the witch herself is not around, the illusion can be projected by some other enchanted objects hidden nearby. It can be:

1) Bones of various small animals.

2) Amulets.

3) Figures made of wood or other materials.

4) Bodies and body parts of various vermin like frogs, snakes, gnats, or lizards.

5) Gifts of nature: gemstones, minerals and other objects of value.
You need to find and break these items for the illusion to dissipate.

[This information might be useful!]

[You read random anecdotes]:

A mage and a scholar visit an exhibition of boring pretentious bore, and the witch at the entrance says, "Sorry, but you can't bring your own!"

"Hey, can you take a look at my back?"

"Revered sorcerer, there's a stake in your back! It must hurt like hell!"

"No... Only when I laugh..."

I'm from a very respectable family. Father is Scholar, mother is Artist, and my sister is Mage. They got these nicknames on their first sabbath.
You see a bookcase full of semi-prohibited works. What should I read...

[You open a random page]:

Contrary to popular belief, not all spells utilize dark magic.

Sorcerers know how to influence the flow of humors in a way that heals the patient. Moreover, these methods can cure ailments of the body and mind and rarely have negative consequences, which cannot be said about medicine.

Witches harness this power from nature itself, acting in accordance with its laws that are unknown to those not privy to this knowledge.

[The book is fairly damaged but you can make out a fragment on a random page]:

An hour later, he was approached by two members of the city council and put under arrest as a sorcerer. They were going to take him to the district head or a judge. When the judge noticed his approach from afar, he gave the order to imprison the "sorcerer" for life without even letting him speak. For three days, the man begged the jailers to explain why he was being treated like this, because he had not done anything wrong.

[You pick up the book Shestokryl and inspect it]:

Heavy spellbook. Old yellowed pages are covered in cryptographic writing. The ink is brownish red. Numerous terrifying pictures with spirits, ugly creatures, corpses, and other vile things. The books is twitching in your hand as though trying to escape.

[You pick up the book Raven Tome and inspect it]:

An ominous book in a dark leather binding. The cover depicts some horrors: screaming people, scary grimacing corpses. The grimoire is locked, but when you hold it up to your ear, you hear ominous whispers coming from its pages. Perhaps it should stay locked.

[You pick up the Dream Book and inspect it]:

A heavy tome of dream interpretations. Most interpretations sound silly but as you take it in your hands, you feel unusually sleepy. You are about to fall asleep. But as soon as you put it down, the sleepy feeling is completely gone.
You see a cupboard full of potions, scrolls and magic tomes. You should probably not touch anything...
How do you feel? Dizzy? Do you see multi-colored spots?

We’re approaching the wormhole to the very sector. No rescue from demons...

Demons! Demons attack!

Damn them, now we have to make a blind jump again. Light save us...

What are you looking at? Hurry to the cannon, shoot them, shoot! We need to break through to the wormhole!
This will be a tight fight! Good luck, wingless!

quests: Beast that Lurks in the Night

t: We were kind of... looking for some provisions. And we sort of... got lost.
Uh-oh, we found no food at all... Bell's gonna give us hell!
I was roughed up pretty bad... My ribs hurt!
What camp? Are you blind? The ogres threw our boys into cages. They wanna eat them alive! Nope, either we get to safety together or we all die.
Well, what do you want? Say what you need and get out. I have a lot of work.
What ship? Are you talking about that pile of metal that used to be our flagship? It is in the Astral, not far from the camp. I don't know about any other ship.

A ship? Yes, I think one recently crashed here. No, not that one that burns at the shore; I heard a crash from the side of the Badger Island. Or maybe it wasn't a ship. I don't know. If you want, you can go and check for yourself, I have lots of work to do.
Quarr, outlander! What brought a wingless one to our house?
Ouch! Did you lose your mind? That hurts! Have you never seen white feathers before?

Damn it! You cracked me, yes? Yet you're dumb, you don't understand anything. We are doing good deeds, but you outlander spoiled everything. I'll leave now; if you try to stop me, I'll kill you and escape.

The box, made from rough boards, is filled with hay and wood chips. The lid is ripped off and lies nearby. It looks like something valuable was transported in it, but was taken out and carried off in an unknown direction.
Aho, child! We've been waiting for you. Listen to what I have to say to those who are about to say goodbye to their childhood and enter their adult life.
I will tear you, you slug!
Leave the dummies for the youngsters, kylys. If you want to prove that you can fight, fight with me.
The Primals don't favor the weak ones. Show that you can fight!
Khoor-Shashin has taught you a lesson, zoor? That's good. Wounds make us strronger than rock and harder than steel! Now drrink this potion, it will stop the bleeding.

Are you speaking about Scar? Rawr! The wicked cat deserves a good thrashing. I think that scoundrel killed our babies, but wolves stand no chance against a tiger.

Wait... I can smell him!

I see no fear in your eyes, strange cub. You can become a hunter... if you survive.

Look, here goes Scar, your enemy. Look into his eyes, cub. If I smell fear in you, I will renounce you, and nothing will save you from prey's fate!
You are alien to this forest, cub. What do you want?

Scar is a dangerous enemy. Sooner or later he will find you, whether the Pack will accept you or not. Maybe you shouldn't put off the inevitable? Surrender now, and maybe the tiger will have mercy and kill you quickly.

No? You are clinging to your life till the last, I like that. Maybe you'll amount to something one day. I will speak my word in your defense.

But even if Akkya accepts you, Scar won't let it go. Come to me after the Council, I will teach you how to fight. Then, maybe, you will live to see another moon.

The brothers have agreed to follow you? Well done, cub!

A big and strong deer lives in the Thicket. You will track him down and drive him to the Council Rock. I will finish him here. Akkya never fails!

Aho, frriend... See how miserable I am? I am too weak, too timid, and the Thicket of the Primals has taken my tya! My tya will soon melt, and tyalla will return to the Eternal Circle to crreate a new tya and give birrth to a new life... Maybe we will meet again in this life, ffriend. Ay-hya! Good-bye!

Humm... What have you awaken me for, gosling? I was sleeping so well. Humm...

The stones are not dead, they are just sleeping. Always sleeping. We don't care about you, you whose life is so short. Don't wake us up, or we will be furious, hurr...

You want to ask me a question? Humm... Why do you need an answer that you wouldn't understand? To understand a stone, you need to comprehend its soul... And you live so shortly, so swiftly. You wouldn't understand, hurr... Don't wake me up again!

Oh, hi! I hope you are not going to hurt my tree? You won't do that, will you? Oh, that's great!

Why did you awake me? We are of different blood with you! The one who walks on the ground cannot understand the one who reaches out towards the sun!

The Pack has already gone to follow the trail of the prey, and only the young cubs are left behind. I want you to lead them on a trail of a deer. You need to learn how to hunt together and act as a whole, because you are - the Pack!

Talk to your brothers. The elder hunters will drive the deer right at you, and then you will have to drive it to the Council Rock. Being a beater is a great honor!

I can do anything. And of course, I can teleport you out of this cave if you have nothing left to do here...
Let's say goodbyes!

So, I returned to this world.
I could just kill everyone, repair the prison that was shattered by the meteorite and forget about Sarn. But it would have been too easy. Watching over my enemy transformation was much more interesting! Do you understand? God of Light has to become a God of Darkness in order to escape!
I decided to add fuel to the fire. I told Junes everything. Told them that their God of Light was a manipulating liar!
Sarn never told them why they had to hunt the Great Dragons. He never warned them that death of the last dragon would destroy the world!
I told them everything. And I made them an offer. They could side with me and keep the world safe, or side with their Creator, and shatter it into pieces!

Junes decided to side with me.
As you can imagine, Sarn got very angry! He cursed them, and that's how the first demon was born - June Curse that almost wiped the entire nation. I managed to save a bunch of people. But the only way to protect them from the Curse was changing their appearance, turning them into entirely different creatures.
Those who did not turn into Wormfaces died. Eventually the Curse weakened, and the last June managed to defeat it.
This is the whole Revelation. What happened next? Sarn made another attempt. He created a new race, the demons. And now he is using them to destroy this world completely.

I'm not going to quote half-witted Tka-Rik. I'll tell you everything in my own words.
When Junes led by Sarn killed most of the Dragon Keepers, these winged beasts, who I left to protect the world, finally asked me for help. At first they hoped to destroy Sarn's children themselves, and therefore hesitated.
But they failed. They were smart enough to capture the Elves with their beauty, and that's it. They couldn't cope with Junes.
Weaklings! Since then I never rely on dragons. And the fact that the last of the Great Dragons betrayed me is just adds to the story.

Not treachery of Draconids, no. They are just obedient servants of their master, the Great Dragon, Father of Fire, the last Dragon Keeper.
The creatures he created followed his will blindly, respected him as a god... Fools.
And as for him, he decided it was a good time to challenge me... He thinks that the power of the Seal makes him almighty!
Well, we'll see...

First thing you should know is that Draconids and Wormfaces act independently.
I think they helped each other to get to this moment, they made a deal perhaps, a temporary alliance against me... But could they forget the old feud?
Of course not. The war between Junes and the Great Dragons continues!
Especially now that they hunt for the same thing. Something that belongs to me. They hope to use it to change their fate.
What is this thing? Oh, this is a topic for another conversation...
We'll talk about it. But not now.

Our allies, Wormfaces and Draconids, betrayed us.
No, they didn't side with Sarn and his demons. They have nothing to do with them.
They decided they could play their own game.
Do you remember the ritual with Spark of Osip at Gipat? Wormfaces used the same ritual to resurrect Zak. They have a leader now - Great Ath-Zak, Conqueror of June Curse! I guess he likes it more than telling stories in ghostly form. Hmm... It's understandable.
But Zak can't defeat Sarn. Fighting the curse of god is not the same as fighting the god himself.

Ruins of the Dead City are the aim of Sarn, Zak and the Great Dragon! The thing they seek is hidden there. Funny, how this bait was intended for Sarn only, but two little fishes swallowed it too... You are going to catch them all!
Here's the plan. You will learn more later.
All that remains of the small but brave soothsayer.
Ugh... we need to break the ice!
Chief... call... battle... glory... memory... awakening...

The Urun are those white evil creatures you fought! They shouldn't be here... They used to attack us, but when we defeated them, they hid in the deepest burrows... If they're roaming around, it's very bad!

Us Gibberlings?

Many! There are several settlements here - Fishermen, Meadmakers... and Skalgard! I need to show you around! Actually, there used to be a lot more of us, but after Yok, Isa became quite small, and now there is barely enough space for the three clans.
This is an incredible event! Wow!
Alright! Follow me and stick close!

Maybe you've heard of it? Or fraternity, at least?

Yes, many people know about fraternity! Brotherhood is a great power, a magical ritual that binds you together...

However, the bond between members of the same sprout is even stronger! There is no one more important to a Gibberling than their family...

Therefore, losing a family member is like losing a limb for a family. And our brother died on Coldberg when the undead attacked the mine...

We then turned to that Orc shaman, Kurgan, and he said there's a Ritual of Blood Brotherhood! Which is even stronger than the ritual of fraternity. And with its help, you can unite those who have lost their relatives into one family!

And then the Orc said he'd lied... Orcs don't have a heart! Everyone knows that.

But perhaps he wasn't lying? And this ritual does exist?
Greetings! It's kind of... beautiful... in a way.

Thank you!

I'll leave the helmet at the memory stone. May it protect my brother's head in his eternal journey.

There you are! Brother Styr has talked my ear off about you and your great hunt. And it wasn't just me - the whole clan had to listen to it!

Thank you for Lyngbakr. From me and Jon. May the wind bring him the news in the land of eternal wanderings.

Oh, is this the same helmet?

Jon was the bravest of the three of us... He dragged Styr and me all over the island, but most of all he dreamed of finding out if there was anything beyond the great Nothing! If he'd lived to this day, then you can’t even imagine how happy he'd be to meet you!

But Fate is more powerful than all of us. And our time is measured in advance...

Thank you for recovering the helmet. Our brother's boat in Misty Harbor will be a good place for the helmet.
